notes.title: Check out Nameless DLCs!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

If you have played Nameless and want something more, check out the DLCs that just have been released.


[h1]1) Nameless OST[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/415040/
This DLC includes 26 game soundtracks and the first secret ending song.


[h1]2) Nameless Character Ending Songs[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/415340/
This DLC includes the full length ending songs of the game characters, MRs and a making film.


[h1]3) Nameless Dummyhead Series[/h1]

Have you heard of a dummyhead mic? If not, [u][b]go to the store pages and listen to the trailers![/b][/u] [u]Make sure you wear earphones![/u]

This drama series shares the same characters from "Nameless ~the one thing you must recall~" but the traits of the characters and the world are drastically different.
[img=https://storage.googleapis.com/cheritz/images/everyone.jpg]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/414670/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/414673/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/414675/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/414672/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/414671/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/414674/


[h1]4) Nameless Black & White Christmas (Dummyhead recorded)[/h1]

Coming soon! (A DLC key will be distributed if you already purchased it from Cheritz Market. This DVD won't be available from the shop soon.)



*If you guys purchased the Nameless Limited Edition, you will be able to find your OST key in the full version download page at [url=shop.cheritz.com]Cheritz Market[/url] soon.
*If you purchased the dummyhead series or the character songs through Audio Comics in 2013, please send an email to help_en@cheritz.com with a proof of purchase to get a DLC key.

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Nameless Updates
notes.content:
Hello Nameless players!

We have 5 important updates:

1. We decided to discontinue support for the Cheritz download client starting from June 30, 2015.
This is to provide more stable services and updates. If you haven't already please request
a Steam key to play the game on Steam.

2. Many reported bugs have been fixed , we added more splash screens, and Steam emoticons.

3. We added Steam Cloud saves. So now you can play the game on multiple computers
and have the same save files!

4. We added Steam User Authentication to the game to prevent people from abusing the game.
So to launch the game you need to be logged into Steam. We now collect IP addresses and your Steam
ID when playing the game.

5. You need a steady internet connection now through the game to play it.

For more information please visit https://shop.cheritz.com/en/steam/info

notes.title: Second Secret Ending Bug Fix on Nameless Steam
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We apologize for the bugs that were in Nameless on Steam.
We made a patch. Please update your game.

Bugs fixed:

1) Unable to get into the second secret route.
For those who are not able to see secret 2 route,
please update your game, click on "forget the name" and type "the" name. (We are trying not to spoil anyone here...^^;;)

2) Scripting issues. A lot of empty texts/wrong text message/typos/activation on memories. Missing ending 1 movie.

Thank you for those who reported the issues.

And happy new year!

[img]http://cheritz.dl.cdn.cloudn.co.kr/static_shop/images/home/happy%20new%20year.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mac Version Tip
notes.content:
Hello,

Mac version is now available. We apologize for the late release.

If you have an issue that the game doesn't let you type the name of your first doll at the beginning of the game,

1) Exit the game
2) Click on "Play" from the Steam launcher while pressing "Option" key. It will bring up a resolution dialog.
3) Try 1024*768 resolution with "Windowed"

You can change the resolution anytime with this method as well.

We thank you for your patience, and have fun!

______________
맥버전이 출시되었습니다. 윈도우 버전에 비해 다소 늦은 출시에 사과드립니다.

게임 초기에 '첫번째 인형의 이름'이 타이핑 되지 않는 오류를 겪고 계신다면, 다음을 따라해주세요.

1) 게임을 종료합니다.
2) 스팀 런처에서 맥의 'Option'키를 누른 채로 플레이 버튼을 클릭해주세요. 해상도 다이얼로그가 실행될 것입니다.
3) 1024*768과 Windowed(윈도우모드)에 체크한 뒤, 플레이해주세요.

해상도를 게임 도중에 바꾸고 싶으시다면 같은 방법으로 하시면 됩니다.

고객여러분들의 양해에 감사드립니다.
